craft_notes: Sthāyin: betweenness assumed. Rows: grant then prove. Rejected: lapse/recoil invention — killed: not in L3. Read aloud: bridge.

lines: The stirring must needs be granted in between: thus proved,
l4.sanskrit_cite: kṣobhaḥ avaśyam eva antarāle abhyupagantavya iti siddhaṃ sāṃkhyāparidṛṣṭaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ guṇatattvam
